title: Pan Panic
description: A frantic one-tap cooking game. Food sizzles on up to six pans at once: tap each pan when its timer hits the green to flip it, tap again to serve. Tap too early and it's raw, too late and it burns. Three ruined dishes and you're fired. Chain perfect flips for tip multipliers, hit Fever for double tips and an extra life, bonk the rats before they steal dinner, and nail the golden lobster. Global leaderboard, shareable results. Free, no download, works on phone.
